title: Account-only user access to Genie One will soon be generally available and enabled by default
body:
In November 2026, account-only user access to Genie One will be generally available and enabled by default. Users added to your account through automatic identity management (AIM) or account-level System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) can then access account-level Genie One without being assigned to a workspace or granted [consumer access](/aws/en/ai-bi/consumers). Unity Catalog continues to govern what each user can see.

Because account-only users can access objects shared with the `all account users` group, review those shares before the change takes effect. To opt out, an account admin can turn off **Account-only users in Genie One** under **Settings** > **Account Settings** in the account console.

See [Account-only user access to Genie One](/aws/en/genie-one/account-only-user-access).
